messages:
anna (platform): seeing 5xx spike on model-route /v1/generate from eu-west-1, looks correlated with new routing policy pushed at 10:02. can we do an emergency soft-route to fallback pool B?

raj (eng): can confirm policy change was the rollout. it added header `x-rl-route: fast-path` matching prefix `/v1/generate` -> weight 80% poolA, 20% poolB. I can flip weights to 10/90. want a global flip or per-customer?

miguel (sre): global flip for now, mitigation only. if we can do it fast, prefer header override at gateway layer not full deploy.

anna (platform): agreed — avoid deploys. Sophia, can the console toggle handle a weight flip+ttl?

sophia (prodops): console has a temporary override endpoint: `POST /internal/admin/routing/override` — body: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","match":{"header":"x-rl-route","value":"fast-path"},"weights":{"poolA":10,"poolB":90},"ttl_secs":600}```
I can apply if ops approves.

sara (oncall-sre): opening incident channel and checklist now. if 5xx rate > 2% for 3 consecutive mins after flip, rollback to previous weights. also watch latency p50/p95 and queue depth.

anna (platform): @sophia go ahead. include `reason: emergency-route-rollback` in metadata. also tag canary metric set: `gateway.5xx_rate`, `gateway.latency.p95`, `poolB.cpu`

sophia (prodops): doing it. curl I'm running: ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://console.internal.redwood/api/admin/routing/override \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","match":{"header":"x-rl-route","value":"fast-path"},"weights":{"poolA":10,"poolB":90},"ttl_secs":600,"meta":{"reason":"emergency header override","triggered_by":"sophia"}}'
```

deploy-bot: override applied by sophia (prodops) — id=ovr_20240315_421, ttl=600s

miguel (sre): metrics now: gateway.5xx_rate from 3.6% -> 1.1% within 30s. p95 latency improved from 740ms -> 420ms. poolB cpu rose to 68%. good sign.

raj (eng): quick note: this routing rule matched on header only; some clients don't send `x-rl-route`. Are we sure fallback poolB handles plain traffic?

anna (platform): good catch. This override only affects header-matched requests. For plain traffic we should queue a separate config: add prefix match fallback to poolB if weight still problematic. But let's monitor for 5 mins before expanding scope.

sara (oncall-sre): adding automated rollback play: if `gateway.5xx_rate` > 2% for 3m OR `poolB.cpu` > 92% for 1m, revert override. I'll push the monitor alert now.

sophia (prodops): alert rule created: ```yaml
- alert: RouteEmergencyRollback
  expr: increase(gateway_5xx_count[3m]) / increase(gateway_request_count[3m]) > 0.02
  for: 3m
  labels: {team: eng-platform}
```

raj (eng): when we revert, we should also capture the exact policy that caused the issue and add a guardrail in the console UI to prevent weight > 50% during ramp without SRE approval. filing a small UI change ticket after stabilizing.

anna (platform): please note timeline in incident notes: policy rolled at 10:02, override at 10:07, metrics improved by 10:07:30. we'll do a root cause after stabilize.

miguel (sre): once stable, recommend permanent fix: patch route matching to require header+path length check; current match was too broad and picked up some heavy long-sequence requests.

deploy-bot: incident #INC-2024-031 opened by sara (oncall-sre).

anna (platform): team: thanks — keep updates short. assign follow-ups: raj -> UI guardrail ticket, miguel -> root cause writeup, sophia -> postmortem notes and apply TTL extension only if SLOs hold.

sara (oncall-sre): documenting now. keeping channel open until 11:00 or until SLOs hold for 30m. :thumbsup:
